partners.mechanism_chain: CEP152 (HGNC:21808) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization; PAFAH1B1 (HGNC:8605) —DISRUPTS→ neuronal migration; neuronal migration —LEADS_TO→ Lissencephaly (HP:0001300); cytoskeletal organization —LEADS_TO→ Microcephaly (HP:0000252); CEP152 (HGNC:21808) —BINDS→ neuronal migration; PAFAH1B1 (HGNC:8605) —BINDS→ cytoskeletal organization. Mutations in CEP152 disrupt cytoskeletal organization, leading to microcephaly. Mutations in PAFAH1B1 disrupt neuronal migration, leading to lissencephaly.
